messages:
maya: quick heads-up — bringing up cerulean-v1 (Q3B quant) on staging. small smoke shows punctuation / spacing weirdness for CJK when prefix KV cache hits. reproducer below, two tiny prompts, compare fresh vs cached path.

maya: reproducer:
```
# prompt A (no prefix)
input: 我今天去了商店，买了……
output: 我今天去了商店，买了。

# prompt B (with cached prefix)
input: [prefix: 上次记录] 我今天去了商店，买了……
output: 上次记录我今天去了商店，买了。
```

maya: notice the missing ideographic comma in the cached path and the prefix glued without a separator. feels like token boundary merge when cache concatenates segments.

jun: can repro on my laptop with the same model + Q3B runtime. saw the prefix tokenized as a single chunk and no spacer token emitted. quick stats:
jun: BLEU (zh->en) baseline (fp16): 28.4, cerulean-v1 Q3B cold: 27.9, cerulean-v1 Q3B warm(kvcache): 25.7

liam_k: oof, -2.2 BLEU on warm path is worrying. any sampled tokenization output?

jun: pasted sample tokenization sequences:
```
# tokenized prefix (warm) -> [U+4E0A,U+6B21,200D] (merged)
# tokenized prefix (cold) -> [U+4E0A, U+6B21] + spacer_token
```

sasha: ran a quick locale sweep (zh, ja, ko) across 200 examples. chrF shows similar drop; zh worst. summary: zh chrF delta: -4.1, ja: -0.9, ko: -0.6. looks like East Asian punctuation/spacing only.

eval-bot: automated-eval finished for cerulean-v1 Q3B on staging: en->zh BLEU 26.1 (baseline model 28.0), zh->en BLEU 25.8 (baseline 28.3). full artifacts at gs://redwood-evals/cerulean-v1/q3b/2026-03-21/

maya: thanks. hypothesis: kvcache concatenation currently inserts raw byte sequence w/o re-checking grapheme boundary or spacer emission for multilingual tokenizers. likely kernel in tokenizer merge logic.

liam_k: can we run a quick opt: on cache retrieval, insert a zero-width-space (U+200B) as soft separator to see if that fixes output formatting? cheap A/B.

jun: did that locally — small improvement in spacing but introduced an extra token in some Japanese compounds (bad). need something locale-aware.

maya: plan: 1) create a bisect job to see when token merge rule changed (tokenizer or runtime). 2) add unit test for prefix+kvcache boundary producing spacer token for CJK. 3) run full suite across quant modes Q3B/Q4A/fp16.

liam_k: adding to my queue. filing triage ticket now. tagging @sasha for the A/B sweep oracle and @jun for the kvcache repro steps.

sasha: I pushed a quick A/B dashboard (link: https://redwood.internal/evals/cerulean-q3b-ab) with per-locale diffs. will add example counterfactuals and highlight samples where punctuation moved.

maya: perfect. if anyone finds a short mitigation we can deploy a canary change to runtime to re-split tokens on merge boundary. otherwise I’ll pause rollout for cerulean-v1 Q3B today. :eyes: 

jun: logs & local repro commands I used: 
```
# reproduce (docker)
docker run --rm -v $PWD:/data cerulean:v1-q3b /bin/bash -c "python repro.py --prompt-file samples/kv-prefix.txt --use-kvcache"
```

maya: cool — keep updates in this thread. moving to triage board. :white_check_mark:
